'''MB-6 Micro-Defender Droids''' were combat [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that were built with high-durability alloys.<ref name="TORWEB" />

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
MB-6 droids were made available in [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' to players who completed three group missions using the Activities Window between [[June 1]], [[2018]] and [[June 3]], 2018, as part of an event celebrating friendship.<ref name="TORWEB" />
